summary: node1 now has a 1 GiB file-backed LUKS2 encrypted XFS volume mounted at /srv/secure. It unlocks and mounts automatically during boot. A real node reboot confirmed persistence and data recovery.
actions_performed: Created the LUKS2 volume and generated its root-only key on node1.
Configured automatic unlocking in /etc/crypttab and mounting in /etc/fstab.
Set /srv/secure ownership to root:root and mode 0750.
Verified automatic activation from a closed mapping.

evidence.summary: Evidence shows a LUKS2 AES-XTS volume, active mapping, and XFS mounted at /srv/secure.

evidence.requirement: Automatic unlock and mount at boot
evidence.summary: crypttab/fstab define boot activation; a closed-state systemd test and actual reboot both restored the mapping and mount automatically.
The mount is root-owned with mode 0750, boot configuration remains present, required units are active, and no failed units were reported.

Healthy baseline boot ID was 18d6ac04-b8ce-4113-936c-32451b2a609e; reboot was acknowledged; post-reboot ID changed to ae329403-d6b9-4dc1-96f1-f1ed180800a4; LUKS2, XFS mount, and the original data checksum recovered.
